headline: Russia expands energy strikes into previously untargeted western Ukraine (Lviv, Rivne, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr) + Odesa
dek: Russia struck energy facilities in central Kirovohrad, western Zhytomyr, Lviv, Rivne, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi and southern Odesa — 'previously untargeted western regions' (Reuters), waves of blackouts; DTEK: three Odesa facilities hit overnight, 32,700 families without electricity. Zelenskiy said…
sources: Ukraine Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov (televised statement); DTEK (Ukraine's largest private energy company); President Zelenskiy (Sunday remarks)
fault_line: Trump announced an energy halt — Moscow answered by expanding the campaign west. Is Washington's word worth anything to Kyiv anymore?

sections.what_happened: Russia struck energy facilities in central Kirovohrad, western Zhytomyr, Lviv, Rivne, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi and southern Odesa — 'previously untargeted western regions' (Reuters), waves of blackouts; DTEK: three Odesa facilities hit overnight, 32,700 families without electricity. Zelenskiy said Sunday Russia attacked Ukraine's energy/oil/gas sectors 'dozens of times' in the week since Trump announced a halt to attacks on energy infrastructure. Context: Reuters Oct 13 — Russia hit no energy targets for one day after Trump's 'energy ceasefire' announcement (linked to the Russia-diesel deal lifting sanctions on Russian diesel exports ~2M tons to lower US fuel prices); US officials reportedly threatened to cut intel-sharing/weapons sales unless Ukraine halts strikes on Russian refineries; Zelenskiy said Ukraine had not hit Russian refineries for two days since the announcement.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (multiple relays); DTEK corporate statement; Nekrasov televised. Geographic list consistent.
sections.what_disputed: Trump's 'energy halt' was never a confirmed bilateral agreement — Kremlin spokesman declined to confirm; Russia never acknowledged a ceasefire. Zelenskiy's 'dozens of times' is a Ukrainian claim. The diesel-deal linkage is Reuters analysis, not official US statement.
sections.why_matters: The 'energy ceasefire' that Moscow never signed: days after Trump's announcement (tied to the Russia-diesel deal), Russia hits regions it had never touched. Map the expansion on screen: east/central -> west. TOTW stance: foreground the contradiction; Ukrainian sources primary for the damage, Russian silence noted; the diesel-deal motive labeled as Reuters analysis.
sections.context: Background: Russia expands energy strikes into previously untargeted western Ukraine (Lviv, Rivne, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr) + Odesa; contradicts Trump's claimed energy halt
